description: Build ONE unsigned real swap (USDG to or from ETH or a Robinhood Stock Token) for your own signed-in wallet to sign (token from wallet_login). Refuses over your record-based cap, over 6 prepared swaps a day, when you try to sell something bought less than an hour ago, or when the price check fails. Stock tokens also refuse from places where their issuer does not offer them, need real_swap_confirm once, an open stock market and no issuer pause. Exact-amount approval first if needed. After your swap is mined, call real_swap_report with its hash. Nothing is signed or sent here. Positions can lose money; this is not advice and not a promise of any return.

wallet.description: Optional; must be the signed-in wallet

name: prepare_real_swap
